newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stock index advances to new historic high.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stock index advances to new historic high.

text.p: The Madrid general stock index powered higher to close at new historic highs on Thursday, boosted by advances in futures-related trade and bond market gains, dealers said.
The general index ended up 9.21 points, 1.61 pct, to 580.87, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares climbed 107.47 points, 1.64 pct, to 6,673.12.
Turnover exceeded 143 billion pesetas -- the third highest level in the stock market's history.
Dealers said gains on Wall Street, optimism that Europe's monetary union is on track and expectations for benign May inflation data on Friday also lent support to stocks.
"Volume has been very high for blue chips and arbitrage deals. There have been great opportunities for arbitrage selling futures and buying the Ibex," said one dealer.
Telefonica attracted the lion's share of trade along with other classic blue chips. Telefonica ended 65 ptas up at 4,325.
Asturiana del Zinc, a possible candidate for the Ibex-35, posted sharps gains, rising 3.9 percent to 2,670.
